reference_sql:
-- Step 1: one row per order. Step 2: one row per store.
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY order_id, store_code
)
SELECT store_code, MAX(order_eur) AS max_order_eur
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY store_code
alternatives: WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, store_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur FROM sales GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT store_code, MAX(order_eur) AS max_order_eur FROM order_totals GROUP BY 1

WITH order_totals AS (SELECT o.order_id, s.store_code, SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur) AS order_eur FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id GROUP BY o.order_id, s.store_code) SELECT store_code, MAX(order_eur) AS max_order_eur FROM order_totals GROUP BY store_code
